Optimal.Notes: A 40 Hz refresh with a 30 fps cap gives perfectly smooth pacing; FSR from 1024x640 keeps image quality acceptable while giving the GPU enough headroom. Textures can be bumped to High since they are largely VRAM-bound and shared RAM is plentiful.

profiles.Summary: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced is a demanding remaster with minimum GPU requirements around the GTX 1630/RX 6400 class — roughly matching or slightly exceeding the Steam Deck's RDNA 2 GPU — making it a challenging title that requires low settings and FSR upscaling to reach a playable 30 fps. The game carries a "Unsupported" Deck rating and only a gold ProtonDB tier, so expect some friction getting it running and potential instability online.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum requirements (GTX 1630 / RX 6400 minimum GPU, closely matching the Deck's RDNA 2 tier) and general Deck hardware capability. On first launch, check frame rate in a busy Los Santos street and fall back to Max Battery settings if you cannot hold 30 fps.

MaxBattery.Notes: Render at 960x600 and let Deck FSR upscale to 1280x800 to relieve GPU pressure; keep TDP at 8 W to maximise battery. Grass and distance scaling are the biggest performance wins on this engine.

KnownIssues: Steam Deck is officially 'Unsupported' by Rockstar; the Rockstar Games Launcher may require workarounds to launch the game under Proton.
Partial controller support only — some menus or the on-screen keyboard may require touch input or a mouse workaround.
In-App Purchases and GTA Online multiplayer may have additional compatibility or anti-cheat issues under Proton.
The game requires an SSD and at least 105 GB of storage; performance on slower or nearly-full drives may degrade further.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Running at full 15 W TDP with GPU pinned at 1600 MHz gives the best frame rates the Deck can realistically sustain; expect dips into the low 30s in dense city traffic. Drop Distance Scaling or Shadow Quality first if frame rate is unstable.

Optimal.Notes: Rendering at 1024x640 with FSR gives a noticeably sharper image than Max Battery while keeping the GPU within reach of a stable 30 fps cap; expect dips in downtown traffic-heavy scenes. This is the best compromise between visual fidelity and playability the Deck can realistically sustain.

ProtonDB gold-tier reports suggest it can run under Proton with effort, but expect significant tuning and potential instability, especially in dense urban areas.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum requirements (GTX 1630/RX 6400 minimum, well above the Deck's ~GTX 1050 Ti GPU), the game's "Unsupported" Deck status, and ProtonDB gold-tier reports indicating it can launch under GE-Proton. On first run, verify the Rockstar launcher clears, then test frame rate in a busy downtown area and drop to Max Battery settings if it cannot hold 30 fps.

MaxBattery.Notes: Render at 960x600 and upscale with FSR to ease GPU load; keep Distance Scaling at 50% to reduce draw calls in open-world traversal. GE-Proton is recommended by gold-tier reporters for better Rockstar launcher compatibility.

KnownIssues: Game is Steam Deck 'Unsupported' — Rockstar Social Club / launcher overlay may block launch or require workarounds under Proton.
Partial controller support only; some menus and UI elements may require mouse/keyboard input.
The Enhanced edition's DirectStorage and high-VRAM requirements stress the Deck's shared 16 GB pool, causing stutters in dense areas like downtown Los Santos.
Online multiplayer (GTA Online) is unlikely to function reliably on Deck due to anti-cheat and launcher requirements.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Targeting 40 fps at 40 Hz gives the smoothest motion the Deck can deliver for this title; the GPU will be fully saturated and thermal throttling is possible during extended sessions. Do not raise settings above High or increase Distance Scaling further — the Deck's 8 CU RDNA 2 GPU cannot sustain 40 fps at native resolution or Ultra settings in this enhanced edition.
